connection: OpenAI Live API, wss://api.openai.com/v1/live/sessions (session.start over a websocket)

session.instructions: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES, then reference_bot_settings.OPENING_RULE with the greeting from redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt, then reference_bot_settings.DELEGATION_PROMPT

responses.instructions: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES, then reference_bot_settings.OPENING_RULE with the greeting from redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt
responses.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions, strict false (optional parameters stay optional)

history: the kept turns as the session's input, text, at session start; the history starts with reference_bot_settings.CONNECTED as the caller's first turn: '(The call has connected. Say your greeting.)'
turn: the service's own turn detection: the caller's line streamed at speaking pace in 100 ms frames, then silence until the turn is over
reply: the live model's transcript; speech it starts over the caller's line counts only past 6 words, and after a reply of backchannels alone the turn waits up to 10 s for the answer; the reply is timed from when the live model starts saying the backend's answer
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
